questions.prompt: Which ancient people are credited with developing the first known alphabet?
questions.fact: Nearly every alphabet in use today, including Greek, Latin, Arabic and Hebrew, descends from theirs.

questions.prompt: What is the term for a mixture of two or more metals?
questions.fact: Bronze was the first widely used one, and adding a little tin to copper made a metal hard enough to name an age after.

questions.prompt: In which sport do competitors ride a wave standing on a board?
questions.fact: Judges score the ride rather than the wave, and competitors are limited in how many waves they may take.

questions.prompt: Which band is fronted by Chris Martin?
questions.fact: They formed at university in London and used four different band names before settling on the current one.

questions.prompt: Which country is entirely surrounded by Italy apart from one neighbour?
questions.fact: It claims to be the world's oldest surviving republic, dating its founding to the year 301.

questions.prompt: Which play features the characters Rosencrantz and Guildenstern as leads?
questions.fact: It takes two minor characters from Hamlet and follows them offstage, where they have no idea what is happening.

questions.prompt: Which company makes the Xbox games console?
questions.fact: It grew out of a proposal to stop Sony's console becoming the main computer in the living room.
